response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), s AS (SELECT bats, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share, (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM c) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT bats, cnt, share, cnt - avg_cnt AS above_avg FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC
